title: The Phantom Menace
description: Trade Federation blockades Naboo. Qui-Gon Jinn discovers Anakin Skywalker on Tatooine, and Obi-Wan Kenobi defeats Darth Maul.
lore: Senator Palpatine secretly orchestrates the crisis from both sides. Anakin’s discovery sets the Skywalker saga in motion.

title: Attack of the Clones
description: Anakin and Padme uncover a separatist conspiracy as the Republic deploys its clone army and the Clone Wars begin.
lore: Count Dooku leads the Separatists while concealing the Sith plan behind the conflict. The clone army will become the instrument of Order 66.

title: Revenge of The Sith
description: Palpatine turns Anakin to the dark side, executes Order 66, and transforms the Republic into the Galactic Empire.
lore: Anakin becomes Darth Vader after believing the dark side can save Padme. Obi-Wan defeats him on Mustafar, while Luke and Leia are born in secret.

title: A New Hope
description: Luke Skywalker joins the Rebellion and destroys the first Death Star during the Battle of Yavin.
lore: Leia hides the Death Star plans in R2-D2, bringing Luke, Han, and Obi-Wan into the Rebellion. The victory becomes the galactic calendar’s defining event.

title: The Empire Strikes Back
tagline: The Rebellion is pushed to the edge
description: The Rebels flee Hoth, Luke trains with Yoda, and Darth Vader reveals the truth about Luke’s father.
lore: Luke leaves Dagobah before completing his training to rescue his friends on Cloud City. Han is captured and frozen in carbonite.

title: Return of the Jedi
description: Luke confronts the Emperor and Darth Vader aboard the second Death Star. Anakin saves his son, and the Empire is defeated at Endor.
lore: Anakin rejects the dark side to save Luke, fulfilling the Chosen One prophecy. The Emperor’s death marks the turning point in the Galactic Civil War.
